name: A. J. Morton
bio: Dr. A. J. Morton of Iowa, whose father farmed at South Heart, announced his practice in June 1884, giving Medora its first local physician. In July 1884 he brought wheat, oats and barley from his father's farm for display at the Cow Boy office.
